[[File:Lake_Thorn_map.jpg|thumb|300px|Position of Lake Thorn on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]]]
The '''Lake Thorn''', also known as '''Lake Bondoma''', was a lake southwest of the city of [[Nashal]] on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It was connected to several rivers, including the [[Aximia River]]. The [[Nashal River Race]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] circuit crossed this lake.<ref name="SWG:NRT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lake Bondoma is one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> However, it is identified as Lake Thorn during the Nashal River Race.<ref name="SWG:NRT" />
